verses.en: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
verses.pt: Então toda a congregação levantou a voz e gritou; e o povo chorou naquela noite.
verses.en_web: All the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
verses.en_bbe: Then all the people gave load cries of grief, and all that night they gave themselves up to weeping.

verses.en: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would God we had died in this wilderness!
verses.pt: E todos os filhos de Israel murmuraram contra Moisés e Arão; e toda a congregação lhes disse: Antes tivéssemos morrido na terra do Egito, ou tivéssemos morrido neste deserto!
verses.en_web: All the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron. The whole congregation said to them, “We wish that we had died in the land of Egypt, or that we had died in this wilderness!
verses.en_bbe: And all the children of Israel, crying out against Moses and Aaron, said, If only we had come to our death in the land of Egypt, or even in this waste land!

verses.en: And wherefore hath the LORD brought us unto this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey? were it not better for us to return into Egypt?
verses.pt: Por que nos traz o Senhor a esta terra para cairmos à espada? Nossas mulheres e nossos pequeninos serão por presa. Não nos seria melhor voltarmos para o Egito?
verses.en_web: Why does Yahweh bring us to this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will be captured or killed! Wouldn’t it be better for us to return into Egypt?”
verses.en_bbe: Why is the Lord taking us into this land to come to our death by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will get into strange hands: would it not be better for us to go back to Egypt?

verses.en: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.
verses.pt: E diziam uns aos outros: Constituamos um por chefe o voltemos para o Egito.
verses.en_web: They said to one another, “Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.”
verses.en_bbe: And they said to one another, Let us make a captain over us, and go back to Egypt.

verses.en: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.
verses.pt: Então Moisés e Arão caíram com os rostos por terra perante toda a assembléia da congregação dos filhos de Israel.
verses.en_web: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: Then Moses and Aaron went down on their faces before the meeting of the people.

verses.en: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of them that searched the land, rent their clothes:
verses.pt: E Josué, filho de Num, e Calebe, filho de Jefoné, que eram dos que espiaram a terra, rasgaram as suas vestes;
verses.en_web: Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of those who spied out the land, tore their clothes.
verses.en_bbe: And Joshua, the son of Nun, and Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, two of those who had been to see the land, giving signs of grief,

verses.en: And they spake unto all the company of the children of Israel, saying, The land, which we passed through to search it, is an exceeding good land.
verses.pt: e falaram a toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, dizendo: A terra, pela qual passamos para a espiar, é terra muitíssimo boa.
verses.en_web: They spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an exceeding good land.
verses.en_bbe: Said to all the children of Israel, This land which we went through to see is a very good land.

verses.en: If the LORD delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.
verses.pt: Se o Senhor se agradar de nós, então nos introduzirá nesta terra e no-la dará; terra que mana leite e mel.
verses.en_web: If Yahweh delights in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it to us; a land which flows with milk and honey.
verses.en_bbe: And if the Lord has delight in us, he will take us into this land and give it to us, a land flowing with milk and honey.

verses.en: Only rebel not ye against the LORD, neither fear ye the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defence is departed from them, and the LORD is with us: fear them not.
verses.pt: Tão somente não sejais rebeldes contra o Senhor, e não temais o povo desta terra, porquanto são eles nosso pão. Retirou-se deles a sua defesa, e o Senhor está conosco; não os temais.
verses.en_web: Only don’t rebel against Yahweh, neither fear the people of the land; for they are bread for us. Their defense is removed from over them, and Yahweh is with us. Don’t fear them.”
verses.en_bbe: Only, do not go against the Lord or go in fear of the people of the land, for they will be our food; their strength has been taken from them and the Lord is with us: have no fear of them.

verses.en: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones. And the glory of the LORD appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel.
verses.pt: Mas toda a congregação disse que fossem apedrejados. Nisso a glória do Senhor apareceu na tenda da revelação a todos os filhos de Israel.
verses.en_web: But all the congregation threatened to stone them with stones. Yahweh’s glory appeared in the Tent of Meeting to all the children of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: But all the people said they were to be stoned. Then the glory of the Lord was seen in the Tent of meeting, before the eyes of all the children of Israel.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, How long will this people provoke me? and how long will it be ere they believe me, for all the signs which I have shewed among them?
verses.pt: Disse então o Senhor a Moisés: Até quando me desprezará este povo e até quando não crerá em mim, apesar de todos os sinais que tenho feito no meio dele?
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to Moses, “How long will this people despise me? and how long will they not believe in me, for all the signs which I have worked among them?
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses, How long will this people have no respect for me? how long will they be without faith, in the face of all the signs I have done among them?

verses.en: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of thee a greater nation and mightier than they.
verses.pt: Com pestilência o ferirei, e o rejeitarei; e farei de ti uma nação maior e mais forte do que ele.
verses.en_web: I will strike them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of you a nation greater and mightier than they.”
verses.en_bbe: I will send disease on them for their destruction, and take away their heritage, and I will make of you a nation greater and stronger than they.

verses.en: And Moses said unto the LORD, Then the Egyptians shall hear it, (for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them;)
verses.pt: Respondeu Moisés ao Senhor: Assim os egípcios o ouvirão, eles, do meio dos quais, com a tua força, fizeste subir este povo,
verses.en_web: Moses said to Yahweh, “Then the Egyptians will hear it; for you brought up this people in your might from among them.
verses.en_bbe: And Moses said to the Lord, Then it will come to the ears of the Egyptians; for by your power you took this people out from among them;

verses.en: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land: for they have heard that thou LORD art among this people, that thou LORD art seen face to face, and that thy cloud standeth over them, and that thou goest before them, by daytime in a pillar of a cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night.
verses.pt: e o dirão aos habitantes desta terra. Eles ouviram que tu, ó Senhor, estás no meio deste povo; pois tu, ó Senhor, és visto face a face, e a tua nuvem permanece sobre eles, e tu vais adiante deles numa coluna de nuvem de dia, e numa coluna de fogo de noite.
verses.en_web: They will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that you Yahweh are among this people; for you Yahweh are seen face to face, and your cloud stands over them, and you go before them, in a pillar of cloud by day, and in a pillar of fire by night.
verses.en_bbe: And they will give the news to the people of this land: they have had word that you, Lord, are present with this people, letting yourself be seen face to face, and that your cloud is resting over them, and that you go before them in a pillar of cloud by day and in a pillar of fire by night.

verses.en: Now if thou shalt kill all this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,
verses.pt: E se matares este povo como a um só homem, então as nações que têm ouvido da tua fama, dirão:
verses.en_web: Now if you killed this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of you will speak, saying,
verses.en_bbe: Now if you put to death all this people as one man, then the nations who have had word of your glory will say,

verses.en: Because the LORD was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.
verses.pt: Porquanto o Senhor não podia introduzir este povo na terra que com juramento lhe prometera, por isso os matou no deserto.
verses.en_web: ‘Because Yahweh was not able to bring this people into the land which he swore to them, therefore he has slain them in the wilderness.’
verses.en_bbe: Because the Lord was not able to take this people into the land which he made an oath to give them, he sent destruction on them in the waste land.

verses.en: And now, I beseech thee, let the power of my Lord be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,
verses.pt: Agora, pois, rogo-te que o poder do meu Senhor se engrandeça, segundo tens dito:
verses.en_web: Now please let the power of the Lord be great, according as you have spoken, saying,
verses.en_bbe: So now, may my prayer come before you, and let the power of the Lord be great, as you said:

verses.en: The LORD is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.
verses.pt: O Senhor é tardio em irar-se, e grande em misericórdia; perdoa a iniqüidade e a transgressão; ao culpado não tem por inocente, mas visita a iniqüidade dos pais nos filhos até a terceira e a quarta geração.
verses.en_web: ‘Yahweh is slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, forgiving iniquity and disobedience; and he will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation.’
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is slow to wrath and great in mercy, overlooking wrongdoing and evil, and will not let wrongdoers go free; sending punishment on children for the sins of their fathers, to the third and fourth generation.

verses.en: Pardon, I beseech thee, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy mercy, and as thou hast forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.
verses.pt: Perdoa, rogo-te, a iniqüidode deste povo, segundo a tua grande misericórdia, como o tens perdoado desde o Egito até, aqui.
verses.en_web: Please pardon the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of your loving kindness, and just as you have forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.”
verses.en_bbe: May the sin of this people have forgiveness, in the measure of your great mercy, as you have had mercy on them from Egypt up till now.

verses.en: And the LORD said, I have pardoned according to thy word:
verses.pt: Disse-lhe o Senhor: Conforme a tua palavra lhe perdoei;
verses.en_web: Yahweh said, “I have pardoned according to your word:
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said, I have had mercy, as you say:

verses.en: But as truly as I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the LORD.
verses.pt: tão certo, porém, como eu vivo, e como a glória do Senhor encherá toda a terra,
verses.en_web: but in very deed, as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with Yahweh’s glory;
verses.en_bbe: But truly, as I am living, and as all the earth will be full of the glory of the Lord;

verses.en: Because all those men which have seen my glory, and my miracles, which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tempted me now these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice;
verses.pt: nenhum de todos os homens que viram a minha glória e os sinais que fiz no Egito e no deserto, e todavia me tentaram estas dez vezes, não obedecendo à minha voz,
verses.en_web: because all those men who have seen my glory, and my signs, which I worked in Egypt and in the wilderness, yet have tempted me these ten times, and have not listened to my voice;
verses.en_bbe: Because all these men, having seen my glory and the signs which I have done in Egypt and in the waste land, still have put me to the test ten times, and have not given ear to my voice;

verses.en: Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked me see it:
verses.pt: nenhum deles verá a terra que com juramento prometi o seus pais; nenhum daqueles que me desprezaram a verá.
verses.en_web: surely they shall not see the land which I swore to their fathers, neither shall any of those who despised me see it.
verses.en_bbe: They will not see the land about which I made an oath to their fathers; not one of these by whom I have not been honoured will see it.

verses.en: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.
verses.pt: Mas o meu servo Calebe, porque nele houve outro espírito, e porque perseverou em seguir-me, eu o introduzirei na terra em que entrou, e a sua posteridade a possuirá.
verses.en_web: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and has followed me fully, him I will bring into the land into which he went. His offspring shall possess it.
verses.en_bbe: But my servant Caleb, because he had a different spirit in him, and has been true to me with all his heart, him I will take into that land into which he went, and his seed will have it for their heritage.

verses.en: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley.) To morrow turn you, and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
verses.pt: Ora, os amalequitas e os cananeus habitam no vale; tornai-vos amanhã, e caminhai para o deserto em direção ao Mar Vermelho.
verses.en_web: Since the Amalekite and the Canaanite dwell in the valley, tomorrow turn, and go into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”
verses.en_bbe: Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites are in the valley; tomorrow, turning round, go into the waste land by the way to the Red Sea.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.pt: Depois disse o Senhor a Moisés e Arão:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.en_bbe: Then the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

verses.en: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, which murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.
verses.pt: Até quando sofrerei esta má congregação, que murmura contra mim? tenho ouvido as murmurações dos filhos de Israel, que eles fazem contra mim.
verses.en_web: “How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, that murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.
verses.en_bbe: How long am I to put up with this evil people and their outcries against me? The words which they say against me have come to my ears.

verses.en: Say unto them, As truly as I live, saith the LORD, as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you:
verses.pt: Dize-lhes: Pela minha vida, diz o Senhor, certamente conforme o que vos ouvi falar, assim vos hei de fazer:
verses.en_web: Tell them, ‘As I live, says Yahweh, surely as you have spoken in my ears, so will I do to you.
verses.en_bbe: Say to them, By my life, says the Lord, as certainly as your words have come to my ears, so certainly will I do this to you:

verses.en: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, which have murmured against me,
verses.pt: neste deserto cairão os vossos cadáveres; nenhum de todos vós que fostes contados, segundo toda a vossa conta, de vinte anos para cima, que contra mim murmurastes,
verses.en_web: Your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness; and all who were counted of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, who have murmured against me,
verses.en_bbe: Your dead bodies will be stretched out in this waste land; and of all your number, all those of twenty years old and over who have been crying out against me,

verses.en: Doubtless ye shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.pt: certamente nenhum de vós entrará na terra a respeito da qual jurei que vos faria habitar nela, salvo Calebe, filho de Jefoné, e Josué, filho de Num.
verses.en_web: surely you shall not come into the land, concerning which I swore that I would make you dwell therein, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.en_bbe: Not one will come into the land which I gave my word you would have for your resting-place, but only Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua, the son of Nun.

verses.en: But your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have despised.
verses.pt: Mas aos vossos pequeninos, dos quais dissestes que seriam por presa, a estes introduzirei na terra, e eles conhecerão a terra que vós rejeitastes.
verses.en_web: But your little ones, that you said should be captured or killed, them I will bring in, and they shall know the land which you have rejected.
verses.en_bbe: And your little ones, whom you said would come into strange hands, I will take in, and they will see the land which you would not have.

verses.en: But as for you, your carcases, they shall fall in this wilderness.
verses.pt: Quanto a vós, porém, os vossos cadáveres cairão neste deserto;
verses.en_web: But as for you, your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness.
verses.en_bbe: But as for you, your dead bodies will be stretched in this waste land.

verses.en: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your whoredoms, until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness.
verses.pt: e vossos filhos serão pastores no deserto quarenta anos, e levarão sobre si as vossas infidelidades, até que os vossos cadáveres se consumam neste deserto.
verses.en_web: Your children shall be wanderers in the wilderness forty years, and shall bear your prostitution, until your dead bodies are consumed in the wilderness.
verses.en_bbe: And your children will be wanderers in the waste land for forty years, undergoing punishment for your false ways, till your bodies become dust in the waste land.

verses.en: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years, and ye shall know my breach of promise.
verses.pt: Segundo o número dos dias em que espiastes a terra, a saber, quarenta dias, levareis sobre vós as vossas iniqüidades por quarenta anos, um ano por um dia, e conhecereis a minha oposição.
verses.en_web: After the number of the days in which you spied out the land, even forty days, for every day a year, you will bear your iniquities, even forty years, and you will know my alienation.’
verses.en_bbe: And as you went through the land viewing it for forty days, so for forty years, a year for every day, you will undergo punishment for your wrongdoing, and you will see that I am against you.

verses.en: I the LORD have said, I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.
verses.pt: Eu, o Senhor, tenho falado; certamente assim o farei a toda esta má congregação, aos que se sublevaram contra mim; neste deserto se consumirão, e aqui morrerão.
verses.en_web: I, Yahweh, have spoken. I will surely do this to all this evil congregation, who are gathered together against me. In this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.”
verses.en_bbe: I the Lord have said it, and this I will certainly do to all this evil people who have come together against me: in this waste land destruction will come on them, and death will be their fate.

verses.en: And the men, which Moses sent to search the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up a slander upon the land,
verses.pt: Ora, quanto aos homens que Moisés mandara a espiar a terra e que, voltando, fizeram murmurar toda a congregação contra ele, infamando a terra,
verses.en_web: The men, whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up an evil report against the land,
verses.en_bbe: And the men whom Moses sent to see the land, and who, by the bad account they gave of the land, were the cause of the outcry the people made against Moses,

verses.en: Even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land, died by the plague before the LORD.
verses.pt: aqueles mesmos homens que infamaram a terra morreram de praga perante o Senhor.
verses.en_web: even those men who brought up an evil report of the land, died by the plague before Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Those same men who said evil of the land, came to their death by disease before the Lord.

verses.en: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of the men that went to search the land, lived still.
verses.pt: Mas Josué, filho de Num, e Calebe, filho de Jefoné, que eram dos homens que foram espiar a terra, ficaram com vida.
verses.en_web: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, remained alive of those men who went to spy out the land.
verses.en_bbe: But Joshua, the son of Nun, and Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, of those who went to see the land, were not touched by disease.

verses.en: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.
verses.pt: Então Moisés falou estas palavras a todos os filhos de Israel, pelo que o povo se entristeceu muito.
verses.en_web: Moses told these words to all the children of Israel, and the people mourned greatly.
verses.en_bbe: And when Moses put these words before the children of Israel, the people were full of grief.

verses.en: And they rose up early in the morning, and gat them up into the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we be here, and will go up unto the place which the LORD hath promised: for we have sinned.
verses.pt: Eles, pois, levantando-se de manhã cedo, subiram ao cume do monte, e disseram: Eis-nos aqui; subiremos ao lugar que o Senhor tem dito; porquanto havemos pecado.
verses.en_web: They rose up early in the morning, and went up to the top of the mountain, saying, “Behold, we are here, and will go up to the place which Yahweh has promised: for we have sinned.”
verses.en_bbe: And early in the morning they got up and went to the top of the mountain, saying, We are here and we will go up to the place which the Lord said he would give us: for we have done wrong.

verses.en: And Moses said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the LORD? but it shall not prosper.
verses.pt: Respondeu Moisés: Ora, por que transgredis o mandado do Senhor, visto que isso não prosperará?
verses.en_web: Moses said, “Why now do you disobey the commandment of Yahweh, since it shall not prosper?
verses.en_bbe: And Moses said, Why are you now acting against the Lord's order, seeing that no good will come of it?

verses.en: Go not up, for the LORD is not among you; that ye be not smitten before your enemies.
verses.pt: Não subais, pois o Senhor não está no meio de vós; para que não sejais feridos diante dos vossos inimigos.
verses.en_web: Don’t go up, for Yahweh isn’t among you; that way you won’t be struck down before your enemies.
verses.en_bbe: Go not up, for the Lord is not with you, and you will be overcome by those who are fighting against you.

verses.en: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and ye shall fall by the sword: because ye are turned away from the LORD, therefore the LORD will not be with you.
verses.pt: Porque os amalequitas e os cananeus estão ali diante da vossa face, e caireis à espada; pois, porquanto vos desviastes do Senhor, o Senhor não estará convosco.
verses.en_web: For there the Amalekite and the Canaanite are before you, and you will fall by the sword, because you turned back from following Yahweh, therefore Yahweh will not be with you.”
verses.en_bbe: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and you will be put to death by their swords: because you have gone back from the way of the Lord, the Lord will not be with you.

verses.en: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and Moses, departed not out of the camp.
verses.pt: Contudo, temerariamente subiram eles ao cume do monte; mas a arca do pacto do Senhor, e Moisés, não se apartaram do arrraial.
verses.en_web: But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain. Nevertheless, the ark of Yahweh’s covenant and Moses didn’t depart out of the camp.
verses.en_bbe: But they gave no attention to his words and went to the top of the mountain, though Moses and the ark of the Lord's agreement did not go out of the tent-circle.

verses.en: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill, and smote them, and discomfited them, even unto Hormah.
verses.pt: Então desceram os amalequitas e os cananeus, que habitavam na montanha, e os feriram, derrotando-os até Horma.
verses.en_web: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites who lived in that mountain, and struck them and beat them down, even to Hormah.
verses.en_bbe: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites who were living in the hill-country, and overcame them completely, driving them back as far as Hormah.
